head_commit.message:
coop: re-match 107 demoted FULL_MATCH functions to byte-identical; sweep re-verified 0 stale

Restores FULL_MATCH after the sweep demoted 299 falsely-certified rows
(pre-r5 certify bug, code-only mark_implemented_bodies checks, renamed
symbols). Fixed source so retail/decomp bodies are byte-identical again:

- Adjusted-this dtor/cbRenderBefore thunks (~80): replace virtual
  dispatch (->~Class()) or frame-creating calls with the direct
  extern "C" tail-call cast ((void(*)(void*))__dt_<mangled>)(p - N),
  which MWCC compiles to the exact retail `subi r3,r3,-N; b target`.
- Global-return accessors (~20): `lwz r3, lbl_eu_XXX; blr` via
  extern "C" u32 func() { return (u32)lbl_eu_XXX; } with the
  retail-owned sbss/sdata global declared extern (not defined locally).
- Struct/layout fixes: CPartyState (drop spurious virtual -> field
  offsets), CScnVirtualLight (u8@0xD0), CScnItemId (pointer return),
  CGXCache (0x510), CMakeCrystalWin (vtable padding), g3d ScnObj
  GetTypeName (drop duplicate extern "C"), CCollepedia, and
  CLibCriMoviePlay @N@ thunk retail annotation.
- Registry symbol sync for retail annotations renamed to MWCC
  @N@/mangled names (convention used by other matched thunks).

All 107 verified via the pipeline byte-identity check
(_byte_identical_with_relocs) and accepted by batch-cycle
(FULL_MATCH certificates, no SMT). Sweep re-run: 0 stale of 9643.
Full demotion list: docs/evidence/decomp/demoted_fullmatch_2026-08-10.md
Re-matched list: docs/evidence/decomp/rematched_demoted_2026-08-10.md

head_commit.message:
voidtype: replace void* data pointers with typed pointers across src/ and libs/

Batched void-typing pass (6 .cpp agents + 6 header agents via paseo):
- 160 .cpp files: void*/const void* params, locals, fields -> concrete types
  (u8*/u32*/class pointers); kept void* where semantics require it
  (libc mem fns, opaque callback payloads, lbl_eu_* anchors, header-pinned
  signatures, mangling-constrained params)
- 65 headers: data fields/globals/typedefs typed; function signatures
  untouched (mangled names + repo-wide call sites)
- Regression-gated per file (hexdiff before/after, byte-identical tables)
  and verified by whole-object byte comparison; full main.dol build+link
  passes

head_commit.message:
fix nand link failures: C linkage for retail-named symbols, extern for retail-owned data

The 5 nand TUs flipped to Matching emitted C++-mangled symbol names while
retail objects/data reference plain C names, breaking the full main.elf
link with undefined (func_804DAF70 etc.) and multiply-defined
(lbl_eu_806659D0/D4/E8/F0/F8/A00) symbols. Add extern "C" to the
func_*/sinit_* definitions and extern to the data declarations so they
reference (not define) the retail-owned sbss slots. Also fix
CHelp_EnemyEnable's func_800B6BC8 declaration (missing extern "C") and
CViewRoot.hpp's data declarations (missing extern, became definitions in
every including TU). main.dol links clean; hexdiff 100% and split sizes
unchanged.

workflow_runs.display_title: CMCEffStart: -O4,s + -func_align 4 fixes unit size gate (was 464 over…

head_commit.message:
CMCEffStart: -O4,s + -func_align 4 fixes unit size gate (was 464 over, now 20 under)

The unit was stuck: 42 byte-identical FULL_MATCH targets sat in BACKLOG because
the decompiled object exceeded its retail split budget (decomp 0x2748 vs
budget 0x2578). Two independent codegen problems caused it:

1. -O4,p vs -O4,s: retail uses stmw/lmw prologues/epilogues; -O4,p emits
   individual lwz/stw pairs. This made 7 init/update/draw functions +8 bytes
   each AND bloated __ct__11CMCEffUpPrm from retail's 0x48 to 0x198 (MWCC
   emitted runtime trip-count division for the pointer-walk loop). With
   -O4,s the constructor compiles to exactly 0x48 (byte-identical) and all
   7 stmw functions match.

2. -func_align 16 vs 4: the 16-byte function alignment added 476 bytes of
   inter-function padding (retail has none; its symbol-sum == section size).
   -func_align 4 eliminates it (padding is placement-only, no code bytes).

Result: decomp .text 0x2568 vs budget 0x2578 (20 spare), size gate PASSES,
83/89 FULL_MATCH rows byte-identical (the other 6 were already stale under
both flag sets — pre-existing rows, not regressions).

The setCrystalInfo reloc-name drift (SDA global + 2 mangled calls) remains,
as do the 4 func_XXXX placeholder rows — separate r7-fix class, tracked for
a later pass.

workflow_runs.display_title: Lint: flag unkN placeholders + UnkClass/UnkVirtualFunc/UnkStruct in n…

head_commit.message:
Lint: flag unkN placeholders + UnkClass/UnkVirtualFunc/UnkStruct in new code

New delta-lint rules (fire only on ADDED lines, so the ~9k existing
generated-ctx unk0/unk4/unkC uses and UnkClass_*/UnkVirtualFunc* types are
untouched):

- no_unk_name: `unk###` identifiers (unk0, unk4, unk8, unkC, unk10, unk48…)
  as locals or field accesses in new code — the model must name the entity
  from the retail symbol/struct layout instead of the placeholder.
- no_unk_generated: `UnkClass_*` / `UnkVirtualFuncN` / `UnkStructN` type and
  member uses (incl. prefixed forms like CActorParam_UnkStruct2) — require a
  real struct/class name from the headers.

Delta semantics verified: pre-existing unk code in unchanged lines passes;
a newly-added unk line is flagged. 127/127 pi-harness tests (3 new lint-cli
tests: unkN flag, UnkClass/UnkVirtualFunc flag, delta-ignores-preexisting).

Fix 155+ compilation errors across kyoshin, monolib, nw4r, and SDK

Subagent-dispatched fixes for remaining build failures:

kyoshin/ (100+ files):
- Remove 'void' return from destructor definitions (10107)
- Convert raw mangled thunks to proper C++ member calls
- Add missing #include for own headers
- Add missing class defs in headers (CfGimmick*, CInfoCf, CfRes*, etc.)
- Add extern declarations for lbl_eu_* symbols
